snippet.title: Sandwich +1 — Announcement Teaser | New idle game about giant sandwiches
snippet.description:
A cozy idle clicker where every click drops a random ingredient with a satisfying plop. Stack towering sandwiches, automate your kitchen, unlock rare fillings, and watch your little workers do the rest.

Wishlist on Steam: Sandwich +1
